7.nullMechanism: Intended null: below the SoC knee the pack accepts regen normally, so true dissipation should be ~0 kW. Mechanism is NOT a clean null: diverted = ref*ns/3.6 - packWh with ref the median decel charge, so any motored second whose charge is below the median decel charge is booked as diverted (one-sided, positive bias by construction; code comment: 'pure method bias'). The control also differs from the target in drive set (66 vs 28 drives) and SoC range. Payload outcome: coastKw 10.8 kW (88 % of ceilingKw 12.2); control is far from null; excessKw 1.4 kW. No interval attached to either value.
7.underlyingRelation: same function, same derivation on the complementary SoC subset (shared_raw_input)

ambiguities: sharedUnverifiedConstant: brief says 'assumed constant'. I used the strict repo sense (verified:false, e.g. CAP_KWH=2.1, 20,000 GTC) and found none in any intersection; if broader assumed processing parameters count (5 s step cap, 1500 ms tolerance, 90/60 km/h drive-type cut-offs, KNEE_SOC 80, locked bound 0.5439) then items 1,2,5,7,8,9,12,13 would be true. Class assignments do not change either way (a shared data input already exists in every item).
Item 1/2: 'released gross throughput' is the sum of master gross_throughput_kwh (no current offset applied, no CAP_KWH); GTC/FCE would add CAP_KWH (verified:false) but are not the named target.

Items 7-13: brief defines class 'negative_control' for these items but the validators are of different natures (complementary subset, emulator control, extremum keys, refit control, known-answer reproduction, decision-rule clause). I gave class=negative_control and the underlying structural relation in underlyingRelation.

Item 8: whether pool drives (40, drawn from slow_all with seed 42) overlap with control drives (100, drawn from slow_ok after the pool draw on the same RNG) was not determined from data; code does not forbid overlap.
Item 10/11: validator estimates serial correlation rho, not the slope; no number-to-number comparison is possible.
Item 3: bufferImpulse extras (bufferExtra: capacityMultiple) use CAP_KWH=2.1 but not the event count; excluded from ancestors of nEvents.
Item 4: model-form selection used full-data blocked CV, so rolling-origin is out-of-time for fitting only.
